description: Customer support resolution agent: investigates a Discord support report across four separate systems through Zetaris, decides with Nemotron, verifies every claim against a source row, then posts a fix, links or opens a GitHub issue, or escalates with an evidence packet.

zetaris.how: Accounts, KB, releases and GitHub issues are four separate datasources (four databases). The researcher sends one federated SQL statement through the Zetaris REST API; the query plan shows four scans with filters pushed down to each source.

world_model.how: Every Zetaris row becomes a provenance-stamped entity (source, row id, via) with agent attribution (agentId = role, runId = question id), plus typed relationships (runs_version, affects, released_as, in_component). Each role's decision is an event. The context builder's structured payload, with selection trace, is what the Nemotron hypothesis and verifier calls receive.

h_mem.how: Each resolution is mined into tiered memory (long_term when verified, working when escalated) using the guide's no-model fallback. Before research, hybrid retrieval (keyword, tag, entity, layer, recency; threshold 0.35, top 5) injects prior resolutions into the model context. If this customer's report was already confirmed on an open issue, Resolve answers without posting a duplicate GitHub comment.

nvidia.how: Nemotron proposes the outcome and independently audits it; a hard verifier still checks every claim against source rows.
